answer_1.quote: Significant progress has been made in abstractive summarization using large language models (LLMs). This approach involves making various generation decisions, such as determining which content to paraphrase and how specific a summary should be.

answer_2.quote: We evaluate the readability with the FRE, GFI and CLI metrics (Sec. 2.2) and BertScore (BS, and the F1 measure of ROUGE-L (RG-L, Lin, 2004) for evaluating the summary quality; and FactCC and UniEval for faithfulness assessment.

answer_4.quote: We conduct human evaluations to determine how readable and informative the CNN/DM generated summaries are, using Amazon Mechanical Turk.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators were shown three summaries at a time and asked to select the most readable and least readable summaries (for readability) and the most informative and least informative summaries (for informativeness).
